scripts.build: pnpm run build:callbacks && pnpm --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm docs:build
scripts.docs:prepare: pnpm run docs:assets && pnpm run docs:api
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm --dir apps/docs run prepare:content && node scripts/vite-dev.mjs apps/docs
scripts.docs:deploy: pnpm dlx wrangler@4 pages deploy apps/docs/dist --project-name=gespenst-docs
scripts.lint: biome check packages scripts demo examples benchmarks harness apps tools docs index.html package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml biome.json tsconfig.json typedoc.json vite.workspace.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.browser.config.ts vitest.browser.compat.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write packages scripts demo examples benchmarks harness apps tools docs index.html package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml biome.json tsconfig.json typedoc.json vite.workspace.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.browser.config.ts vitest.browser.compat.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm release:pack && pnpm test:pack -- --archives .release/npm
